doc.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

title: Starting on clarinet by accident
summary: A friend in Dalry lent him a clarinet, which began his playing.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Wow. And was the saxophone your first instrument of choice?

Clarinet. And that came purely by accident. One of my pals in Dalry, I was in his home one day and they had a tremendous collection of musical instruments all over the place. And he happened to say, “Would you like to borrow a clarinet?” And I said, “Sure, I’d love to.” If he had said trombone I would have tried the trombone. So that’s how it all began.
